name: Kanban and Pomodoro

props.text: Click a card to edit; drag it to another stage. Scroll the board with the mouse wheel or Up/Down buttons.
Task title                                     Due date: YYYY-MM-DD (optional)             Stage

events.Click:
# Handle this designer control.
kanban_edit(self, True)

# Handle this designer control.
kanban_file(self, True)

props.text: Focus ready; choose minutes then Start.

startup:
# Initialize an unsaved example board; file writes and the timer require explicit actions.
self.cards = [{'id':'sample','title':'Explore this editable Kanban template','due':'','stage':'To do'}]
self.selected = None
self.dragging = None
self.dirty = True
self.focus_timer = None
self.focus_generation = 0
self.focus_running = False
self.focus_remaining = 0
self.focus_sessions = 0
self.Stage.set('To do')
self.Minutes.insert(0,'25')
self.Board.bind('<Button-1>',lambda event:kanban_select(self,event))
self.Board.bind('<B1-Motion>',lambda event:kanban_drag(self,event))
self.Board.bind('<ButtonRelease-1>',lambda event:kanban_release(self,event))
self.Board.bind('<MouseWheel>',lambda event:self.Board.yview_scroll(-1 if event.delta > 0 else 1,'units'))
self.Board.bind('<Button-4>',lambda event:self.Board.yview_scroll(-1,'units'))
self.Board.bind('<Button-5>',lambda event:self.Board.yview_scroll(1,'units'))
self.Form1.protocol('WM_DELETE_WINDOW',lambda:kanban_close(self))
kanban_draw(self)
self.Form1.deiconify()
